Overview

Coyhaique is a city in AI with a population of 60,000. The capital of Chilean Patagonia, a remote city surrounded by pristine wilderness and outdoor adventure opportunities. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 140 sunny days a year.
